name: compact-timing
description: Compacts the conversation at task boundaries instead of at a fixed token count: the model marks the session busy or at a boundary, and the plugin compacts at the end of a turn when the mark and the context size allow it

boundaryTokens.title: Boundary tokens
boundaryTokens.description: At a marked boundary, compact when the context holds at least this many tokens

softTokens.title: Soft limit tokens
softTokens.description: Without a busy mark, compact when the context holds at least this many tokens. Keep autoCompactWindow above this as the hard limit
